hotels.title: Maldives All-Inclusive Villas with Unlimited Free-Flow Drinks & Return Seaplane Transfers
hotels.description: Step into a world of laidback luxury and all-inclusive indulgence at this stunning villa-only retreat set on a turquoise lagoon in the untouched South Nilandhe Atoll. Whether you choose a beachfront villa surrounded by lush palms, an overwater sanctuary with direct lagoon access or a blend of both, each space is thoughtfully designed for uninterrupted relaxation. Here, the days are yours to shape. Savour daily meals across a variety of venues - from beachfront buffets at Kaani Restaurant to poolside delights at Kuredhi Pool Bar. Enjoy daily afternoon tea, and sip your way through free-flow cocktails and drinks served throughout the day. When adventure calls, dive into vibrant marine life with complimentary snorkelling gear, paddle across the lagoon or explore over 30 nearby dive sites with expert guidance from the PADI five-star Gold Dive Centre. Kids can join in the fun at the lively Rangers’ Club, while adults unwind with open-air spa rituals at Angsana Spa - offering a remedy for every need - or take a refreshing dip in the sparkling infinity pool framed by white sandy shores and loungers. With seamless roundtrip seaplane transfers included, your unforgettable Maldivian escape begins the moment you land.
